fragments.text: The jobless rate remains low at around 4.1 percent, and both job openings and weekly hours have been increasing.

summary.text: Chairman Warsh said inflation remains elevated, while the jobless rate remains low at around 4.1 percent, and the Committee’s predominant focus is price stability.
